owner_basis: Owner 2026-11-01: 'USE THEM ALL' (provider utilization fix) + DOE-FAMILY rule 6 (design around continuous live production; routes re-verified, never pinned).
hypothesis: Under DoE-governed allocation across the eligible inference endpoint pool, Scout task-fit selection realizes the assigned treatment; endpoint-level correctness, reliability, latency, cost and rework differ measurably by endpoint and configured instance.

design.units: Live desk dispatches (challenge-entry builds + fleet build tasks) in the window — the continuous production flow itself; no synthetic units.
design.factor: Inference endpoint (provider + execution surface + model@version + protocol), with configured-instance identity retained separately; endpoint-specific task class and manager customization are declared factors where the campaign design admits them.
design.assignment: DoE owns allocation and rotation. The active design assigns the treatment/endpoint distribution; Scout selects an eligible endpoint from the existing pool to realize that assignment using live task-fit, capability, credential, catalog, quota and health evidence. Manager/requester-specific provider constraints are allowed only through a recorded custom contract and separate treatment/stratum. No global no-repeat rule.
responses: first_pass_success (PR merged with no rework dispatch)
action_required stalls (wiring health, per rule 6 re-verification)
design.window_rule: first 24 fully stamped dispatches OR 2026-12-01, whichever first; n>=4/endpoint is descriptive reporting only. No endpoint significance, ranking, cull or promotion claim until its pre-registered endpoint-level statistical gate is satisfied.
design.cull_rule: No endpoint is culled or promoted from a pooled mean or point estimate alone. DoE applies the pre-registered per-endpoint significance/effect-size/sample/stopping gates; otherwise status remains NOT_ESTABLISHED. Any later design amendment is versioned and prospective.
guardrails: DoE assignment is authoritative; Scout selection must preserve the assigned treatment and emit a selection receipt
no manager/provider hard-pick outside an approved, priced custom contract
custom-contract participants are separately stratified and are not pooled into the standard randomized cohort unless pre-registered
no global no-repeat or fixed alternation rule; repeat assignment is controlled by the active DoE design
quota cost per dispatch recorded via usage slots when the provider returns them (schema rev 1.1)
endpoint-level significance is required; pooled/provider-family results cannot substitute for endpoint-specific evidence
private participant strategies are not emitted in public experiment records

automation.identity: records carry the canonical inference-selection receipt reference and instance_key where available; endpoint-level identity is provider + surface + model@version + protocol, not provider alone

conditional_provider_arms.model_identity: dynamic per-key GET /v1/models; no static model IDs
activation_gates: AGENTROUTER_API_KEY is present in approved secret storage and is never exposed in records
native inference transport is separately reviewed and allowlisted; catalog registration is not inference admission
explicit spend ceiling and stop switch are approved
data classification and provider data-handling terms are reviewed
observation_requirements: desk stamp includes provider, selection_reason and ts
first real desk-stamped dispatch after activation is required before the arm is counted or scored; it is an observation requirement, not an activation gate
record exact model_id and protocol plus workflow/run/attempt correlation when available
record provider-reported input/output/total/quota tokens, usage_cost and latency/performance metrics when returned; preserve additional sanitized provider metric names and values with provenance
keep account-wide quota balance and reset unknown until a separate authoritative documented account signal exists
record first_pass_success, rework_cycles, dispatch_to_pr_wall_time and stalled_action_required
conditional_provider_arms.activation_rule: Activate only after every listed activation gate passes. The first real desk-stamped dispatch is required as post-activation evidence before the arm is counted or scored; a registry/catalog row alone is not an eligible inference arm.
auditor_projection_fields: provider_metrics (sanitized scalar values with per-metric source timestamps and provenance)

owner_amendment.authority: DoE owns inference endpoint allocation, rotation, experimental assignment, significance gates, culling and promotion.
owner_amendment.scout_role: Scout selects an eligible provider/model endpoint from the existing pool to realize the DoE-assigned treatment, using live task-fit and eligibility evidence. Scout does not define allocation weights or independently promote/cull endpoints.
owner_amendment.manager_role: Manager/requester may use the standard DoE allocation or request custom inference settings through a priced contract. A contracted constraint is recorded as a distinct treatment/stratum and is not silently mixed into the standard randomized population.
owner_amendment.endpoint_unit: Provider + surface + model@version + protocol/endpoint identity. Each inference endpoint is evaluated independently; pooled results do not establish endpoint-level significance.
owner_amendment.significance: Per-endpoint claims require a pre-registered test, alpha, effect threshold, sample plan, stopping rule, confidence interval and multiplicity treatment. Until all declared gates pass, endpoint standing is NOT_ESTABLISHED. Existing n>=4 reporting is descriptive only.
owner_amendment.rotation: No global no-repeat or fixed alternation rule. Repeats and allocation proportions are determined by the active DoE design.
owner_amendment.exemptions: Owner and any other explicitly authorized exempt roles are declared in the design/receipt and excluded from ordinary participant constraints; exemption does not silently alter experiment records.
owner_amendment.privacy: Active participant bidding, ante, wallet-management and trading strategies remain private. Public records carry only non-sensitive commitments, references and state. Release on cull is governed by the recorded disclosure policy; never commit secrets or plaintext private strategies to a public repository.
